about:
Surplus Electronics Sales operates from Arcanum, Ohio, where it has been in business for 11 years. The company is an online-only retailer with no physical storefront and does not accept phone orders. Ownership details and founders are not disclosed.

The company specializes in the distribution of surplus electronic components, offering over 1,000 items across categories such as capacitors, resistors, fuses, connectors, semiconductors, inductors, and hobbyist motors. Orders placed before 1:00 PM EST typically ship the same day via USPS with delivery confirmation; otherwise they ship the next business day, with transit times of two to five days.

Its customer base includes academic institutions, hobbyists, and service personnel. The product catalog spans automotive fuses, test equipment, tools, and a wide range of passive and active components, serving education, hobbyist, and maintenance sectors.

The business emphasizes reliable service and customer service, with secure payment processing through PayPal and SSL encryption. It was founded to provide a convenient online source for surplus electronics, though the specific founding motivation is not publicly stated.
